Settings

Exercise catalogue
Optional, and off. WorkoutX has 1,400+ exercises with truly animated demos, but it's metered at 500 requests a month and it was the source of every blank tile. The free demo pack below covers the same ground with no key and no limit, so nothing here is needed any more. Your key stays saved — switch this on whenever you want the animation back.
Free plan: 500 requests a month. A full sync uses about 120 of them, once. Get a key at workoutxapp.com.
Use WorkoutX
Off by default. The free demo pack covers the same ground with no key and no monthly limit. Turn this back on if you want WorkoutX's animated clips and have requests left.
Restores from your cloud backup if there is one (free), otherwise downloads from WorkoutX.
Talking to your coach
What kit you have here
Set this per location — Dubai, Madrid and Greece are different gyms. Once you're on your heaviest dumbbell the coach stops asking for more weight and starts asking for more reps.
Progression
The load stays the same for every set of an exercise, and only goes up once you've completed the full number of sets at that weight with the reps holding up and it feeling about right or easier. "About right" is the weight to repeat, not to jump from.
Sets to master 4 sets
Complete this many sets at one weight, feeling about right or easier, and the coach adds load next session. Anything less and it holds.
Suggest a weight for new exercises
On, it offers a deliberately light feel-out weight for a movement you have never logged. Off, it just says it is new and leaves the judgement to you.
Off (the default), long explanations show their first couple of lines with the rest a tap away, so the numbers aren't buried in prose you have already read. On, every explanation is shown in full, everywhere, the way it used to be. Nothing is ever deleted either way.
Rest timers
These are the defaults. Any exercise can override its own between-sets rest on the Train sheet, and the coach can change either when it has a reason to — but nothing is fixed any more.
Between sets 90s
Between exercises 2 min 30s
While a timer is running, −15 and +15 on the timer itself adjust it and remember it for next time.
Exercise demos
The buttons in this first block only apply when WorkoutX is switched on above. Demos it fetches are now saved onto this phone permanently instead of being re-bought on every render, which is what drained your allowance. If WorkoutX is off, skip to the free demo pack below — that's where everything comes from now.
Fetch missing demos automatically
Leave this OFF. With it off nothing is ever downloaded unless you press a button below — which is what stopped happening quietly in the background.
About one request per movement — roughly 5–11, once each.
800+ public-domain exercise demos from the Free Exercise DB, hosted free on GitHub. Downloaded once, matched to your library, saved on this phone. Each one is a start and end frame that the app animates, so you get the movement, not a still. This never touches your WorkoutX allowance.
AI coach
Stored only on this device and never synced to the cloud — if your data was cleared you'll need to paste it again. Get one at platform.openai.com/api-keys. Needs a paid account — gpt-5.5 & photo analysis don't work on the free tier.
Coach's memory
Injected into every coach reply.
Morning reminder
Profile and rules
Dubai = full gym. Madrid = dumbbells only. Greece = no equipment. Your daily check-in sets this too, so the coach always knows what you can actually lift.
The look you're aiming at. The coach programs the ratios that build it — and refuses the ones that don't.
When you want to be as close to it as possible. It sets the switch-over from stripping fat to building, and it's why the plan can tell you whether you're on pace.
Voice and tone only — training rules go in the box below. Syncs to the cloud, so you set it once.
Integrations
App and storage
Recover lost data
The app keeps three copies on this device: the main store, a backup copy, and an IndexedDB mirror. If your history vanished, check here first — one of them often survives.
Cloud sync
Deleting the app from your phone deletes its local storage with it. Cloud sync is the only thing that survives that. Set it up, then tap Check my cloud backup — if that doesn't say "Backup found", you are not backed up.
Your training history lives on this device (localStorage + IndexedDB) and survives redeploys — a new index.html on the same domain never wipes it. Turn this on and every lift is also mirrored to your own Firebase project, so it survives a lost phone, a cleared browser, and syncs across devices. Photos and chat stay local (too big for a Firestore doc).
✅ Firebase is already filled in for your PTchat project — nothing to paste. Just switch on Firestore and Anonymous sign-in in the Firebase console.
Firebase console → Project settings → Your apps → Web app → SDK setup & config. Enable Firestore and Anonymous sign-in (Authentication → Sign-in method).
Any word you like. Use the same one on every device to share history. Document path: amirpt/<sync id>.
Sync enabled
Also sync my API keys
Saves re-pasting your OpenAI and WorkoutX keys on every device. Only turn this on if your Sync ID is private — anyone who reads this page's source can see the Sync ID, and the rules let any signed-in user read that document.
Data and backup
Your data is saved on this device and mirrored to a backup, so redeploying a new version won't wipe it. For total safety, export a backup file now and then — you can restore it on any device.
